features: Base plate 63.4x50.7x2.54 with R8 rounded corners
Four Z-axis through holes diameter 5, inset 5.5mm from both edges near each corner
Two parallel thin lugs (5mm thick in X), 12mm gap, symmetric about X=0
Each lug profile: rectangular 20mm wide in Y rising from Z=2.54, topped by semicircular arc R10 centered at Z=23.04
Single pin hole diameter 8 along X axis through both lugs, centered at Y=0, Z=23.04
Fillet R3 at lug-to-plate root intersection
assumptions: Assumed plate thickness 2.54mm applies uniformly across full plate including rounded corners
Assumed the two lug holes, being colinear and coaxial with a gap between lugs, count as a single hole per the clevis rule
Assumed fillet at lug root (R3) has negligible effect on volume estimate
Assumed hole inset of 5.5mm is measured from plate edges (not rounded corner arc) for hole center placement
Assumed uniform wall thickness and no additional undocumented features (e.g., chamfers)
